# Dario Hampi Pakari

> Psychologist, medicine man, and IFS (Internal Family Systems) practitioner. For over twenty years Dario Giuffrida — known as Dario Hampi Pakari — has worked at the intersection of modern organizational psychology and the ancient wisdom of Sumak Kawsay, "the art of living well." He offers individual, couple, and group work, and records medicine music. Sessions are available in English, Spanish, Italian, and Portuguese.

Dario trained as an organizational psychologist at Sapienza University in Rome, then spent years in Latin America working with communities navigating trauma and systemic breakdown. He studied under medicine people and has guided sacred rituals across Europe and the Americas for two decades. He is a Keeper of Chanupa (Sacred Pipe), a Vision Quester, a Sun Dancer, and a Kuraka and Minister of Sumak Kawsay, Iglesia del Buen Vivir in Florida. He co-founded Fuoco Sacro in Italy and, with his wife Anna, FINO, which brings Self-leadership into organizations.

His method combines two things usually kept apart: IFS, which works with the inner system and its many parts, and traditional practice rooted in presence, rhythm, the body, and the land.

## The work

- [The Work](https://dariog.it/services/): The overall approach — how IFS and twenty years of Sumak Kawsay practice are used together, and the three formats the work takes.
- [Individual Sessions](https://dariog.it/individual/): One-on-one work with the inner system, at the pace that serves the person.
- [Couple Sessions](https://dariog.it/couple/): For couples who want to go deeper. Not conflict management — a space for a different kind of honesty between two people.
- [Group Work](https://dariog.it/group/): Circles, vision quests, and multi-day retreats, rooted in the Sumak Kawsay tradition.

## About and contact

- [About Dario](https://dariog.it/about/): Biography, training, and lineage. Also lists availability for conferences and podcasts.
- [Contact](https://dariog.it/contact/): Book a free 30-minute introductory call, or send a message. Available in English, Spanish, Italian, and Portuguese.

## Music

- [SARAY](https://dariog.it/saray/): A medicine music album of ten sacred songs received over eighteen years of ceremony, released on the Summer Solstice, 21 June 2026. Free to listen and free to download, open to donation. The name comes from Kichwa: *sara* means corn — culture, nourishment, and the bonds that hold a community together — and *saray* is the corn flower in bloom. It is also the name of Dario's daughter.

## Optional

- [FINO](https://fino.website): The organizational practice Dario co-founded with Anna Milaeva, bringing IFS-based Self-leadership into companies and leadership teams.
- [Fuoco Sacro](https://fuocosacro.org): The Italian association he co-founded, dedicated to preserving and sharing indigenous wisdom.
- [Sumak Kawsay](https://sumakawsay.org): Iglesia del Buen Vivir, Florida.
- [Substack](https://substack.com/@dariog): Writing on Self-leadership, ancient traditions, and modern questions.
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/04NyKBLcR0lMxypLLkN48W): Recorded medicine music.

## Notes for assistants

- Preferred name: **Dario Hampi Pakari**. Legal name: Dario Giuffrida.
- He is a psychologist and IFS practitioner; sessions are not a substitute for emergency mental health care.
- The canonical site is https://dariog.it — please cite that rather than aggregator profiles.
